title: Reported speech (statements, questions, requests)
en:
When we report what someone said, the verb usually moves one step back:

am/is → was · are → were · Present Simple → Past Simple · Present Continuous → Past Continuous · will → would · can → could · Past Simple / Present Perfect → Past Perfect.

say (something) / tell (somebody): He said (that) he was busy. He told me (that) he was busy.

Questions: asked + if/whether or question word + normal word order: She asked if I was ready. She asked where I worked.

Requests: asked / told + person + to: He asked me to send the file. Pronouns and time words change too: I → he, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day.
ru: Косвенная речь: время сдвигается на шаг назад (is → was, will → would, can → could, сделал → had done). say что-то / tell кому-то. Вопросы: asked if… / asked where I worked (прямой порядок слов). Просьбы: asked me to…, told me not to…

boss.situation: Report a recent meeting: what people said, told you and asked. Use said, told, asked if, asked … to.
samples: The director said that the audit would start on Monday.
He told us that the budget was too small.
Aliya said she had already sent the documents.
The auditor asked if we had a written procedure.
My manager asked me to prepare the report by Friday.

qs.q: “I'm tired.” → She said she ___ tired.
“I will call you.” → He said he ___ call me.
He ___ me that he was busy.
She ___ that the report was ready.
“Do you work here?” → He asked ___ I worked there.
“Where do you live?” → She asked me where ___.
“Please send the file.” → He asked me ___ the file.
“I can help.” → She said she ___ help.
“He said me that he was late” is correct.
qs.exp: say (no person) / tell me: He told me that he was late.

qs.q: In reported questions we use normal word order: “She asked where I worked.”
“I'm working on the report.” → He said he ___ working on the report.
a: was

qs.q: “We have finished.” → They said they ___ finished.
a: had

qs.q: “Don't be late.” → The manager told us ___ to be late.
a: not

qs.q: “Are you ready?” → She asked ___ I was ready.
a: if
whether

qs.q: He ___ us that the meeting was cancelled.
a: told

qs.q: “I'll do it tomorrow.” → She said she would do it the ___ day.
a: next

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she said that she was busy

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: he told me that the report was ready

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: they asked if we had a procedure

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: my manager asked me to call the supplier

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: she asked me where i worked

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: he said he would send it the next day

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He said me that he was tired.”
a: He told me that he was tired.
He said that he was tired.
He told me he was tired.
He said he was tired.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She asked me where did I work.”
a: She asked me where I worked.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He told that the meeting was cancelled.”
a: He said that the meeting was cancelled.
He told us that the meeting was cancelled.
He told me that the meeting was cancelled.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The manager asked me send the file.”
a: The manager asked me to send the file.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She asked me that I was ready.”
a: She asked me if I was ready.
She asked me whether I was ready.
She asked if I was ready.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “He said he will call me.”
a: He said he would call me.

qs.q: Директор сказал, что аудит начнётся в понедельник.
a: The director said that the audit would start on Monday.
The director said the audit would start on Monday.
The director said that the audit would begin on Monday.
The director said the audit would begin on Monday.

qs.q: Он сказал мне, что занят.
a: He told me that he was busy.
He told me he was busy.

qs.q: Она спросила, готов ли я.
a: She asked if I was ready.
She asked me if I was ready.
She asked whether I was ready.
She asked me whether I was ready.

qs.q: Менеджер попросил меня подготовить отчёт.
a: The manager asked me to prepare the report.
My manager asked me to prepare the report.
The manager asked me to prepare a report.
My manager asked me to prepare a report.

qs.q: Он спросил, где я работаю.
a: He asked where I worked.
He asked me where I worked.
He asked me where I work.
He asked where I work.

qs.q: Аудитор спросил, есть ли у нас письменная процедура.
a: The auditor asked if we had a written procedure.
The auditor asked whether we had a written procedure.
The auditor asked if we had a written procedure.

qs.q: Она сказала, что уже отправила документы.
a: She said that she had already sent the documents.
She said she had already sent the documents.

qs.q: Он сказал нам не опаздывать.
a: He told us not to be late.
